title: Dialogs show no visible selection; /model does not close or confirm a pick
observed: The selected row's raised background died at its first colour reset, covering only the first cell; colour mode had no gutter marker. /model applied a pick but stayed open with no confirmation, and its effort row was a static 'Medium' whose arrows did nothing
expected: A › marker and a full-width highlight on the selected row in every dialog; a /model pick closes the dialog and leaves 'Model set to …'; ←/→ changes the session's real effort
